William Saliba is, of course, now fit and available, although the fact that Cristhian Mosquera came on for Konsa on Wednesday may hint at lingering reservations about when and where to introduce the Frenchman. News Ryan Sessegnon returns this weekend after completing a three-match ban. This is seemingly a settled side, with eight players ever-present starters over the last six Gameweeks. Sander Berge would have surely made it nine were he not ill in Gameweek 8, while the two full-backs had a solitary breather after the last international break. And there seems little reason to change it this week, off the back of two wins and a commendable performance at Aston Villa. Jack Butland (shoulder) is at least injury-free and back in training now, getting a run-out for the under-21s on Monday as he builds match fitness. The Leeds boss was less positive about Noah Okafor (adductor) and Anton Stach (broken toe), who have been plagued by recurring pain in recent weeks, describing them as “major doubts” yet again. In better news, Joe Rodon (hamstring) is back in full training, while James Justin and Gabriel Gudmundsson are also fine after picking up knocks last weekend. Doubts over Stach and Okafor means it's likely that Harry Wilson and Daniel James keep their places, then, and that pair actually had decent games against Bournemouth anyway. News Hugo Ekitike (Achilles), Conor Bradley (knee), Jeremie Frimpong (hamstring) and Giovanni Leoni (knee) are all still out but the Reds have no new concerns from the midweek loss in Turkey. Ryan Gravenberch (heel), who missed UEFA Champions League duty, could also yet feature if he can "deal with the pain" of his niggling issue. It's a mostly straightforward predicted XI this week, with Alexander Isak, Milos Kerkez, Florian Wirtz, Ronald Araujo and Cody Gakpo returning to the line-up after midweek breathers. You'd imagine that Bradley Barcola reverts to his usual duties out wide, too, after the ill-fated experiment of using him through the middle against Fenerbahce - although successive 90 minutes for the Frenchman does raise the outside possibility of Rio Ngumoha starting in his stead.

After 90 minutes in Germany on Wednesday, the scene is set for Josko Gvardiol to return at full-back. Jeremy Doku and Ruben Dias will very likely come back in, too, following their own midweek breathers. Luke Shaw (unspecified) and Marcus Rashford (hip) look set to miss out again, too, while Lisandro Martinez serves a one-match ban after his sending off in Gameweek 9. Patrick Dorgu (hamstring) has trained this week, however, and could be involved, albeit only as a substitute at best. Ewen Jaouen (hamstring) and Tino Livramento (unspecified) also remain out.
